name: Wrapped Ether

expectedCapabilities.justification: Minting is permissionless and mechanical. Anyone deposits ETH and receives WETH one to one. No privileged party controls it.
expectedCapabilities.constrainedBy: Contract logic. The mint is fully collateralised by design and cannot be called selectively.

evidence.detail: symbol() = WETH, decimals() = 18, 3124 bytes of code. No admin, no proxy, contract is immutable.
The canonical WETH9 contract has been unchanged since deployment in 2017.

caveats: This is the reference case for a token with no admin capability whatsoever.
